LEVEL_1_DIRECT_OBSERVED.confidence_explanation: Heuristic score based on direct GPS stop-crossing observations on North GT Road (n >= 3). High empirical support for this link under October 2026 conditions; NOT a calibrated probability.

LEVEL_2_HISTORICAL_BASELINE_M0.confidence_explanation: Heuristic score: M0 corridor-level velocity or route baseline fallback. Lower empirical support; NOT a calibrated probability.
LEVEL_2_HISTORICAL_BASELINE_M0.warning: Default corridor baseline scaled with local detour factor k=1.262.

LEVEL_3_EXPERIMENTAL_RF.confidence_explanation: Heuristic score: Candidate Random Forest ML prediction. Conformal radius provides bounded intervals under historical coverage assumptions, but point confidence is a heuristic rank score; NOT an empirical probability.
LEVEL_3_EXPERIMENTAL_RF.warning: Candidate Random Forest ML model (experimental, unverified network-wide).

LEVEL_4_GTFS_SCHEDULED.confidence_explanation: Heuristic score: Static GTFS timetable running time for unobserved corridors. Low confidence because static schedules fail to reflect real-world Delhi congestion; NOT a calibrated probability.
LEVEL_4_GTFS_SCHEDULED.warning: Unobserved corridor: static GTFS timetable running time applied. Low confidence.

LEVEL_5_STATIC_FALLBACK.confidence_explanation: Heuristic score: Static Euclidean distance fallback (15 km/h assumed bus speed) for missing or invalid schedule. Extreme low confidence; speculative heuristic, NOT a calibrated probability.
LEVEL_5_STATIC_FALLBACK.warning: Missing or invalid timetable running time: static distance-based fallback applied. Extreme low confidence.
